capabilities: Push notes to Taggr to publish them in feeds
Pull Taggr posts into the vault as markdown files organized by realm
Convert [[wiki links]] to Taggr post links and back for bidirectional backlinks
Upload and pull images inline with the posts
Publish or unpublish posts via a frontmatter checkbox, including irreversible deletion
disambiguation: Not a general vault sync tool; it syncs only its configured folder with the Taggr platform.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that the seed phrase is stored locally in plaintext, deletion on the blockchain is irreversible, and conflict resolution always lets the remote version win. Publishing costs cycles (1000 credits ≈ $1.37), with free starter credits available via the Obsidian-specific registration page. Development docs (architecture, logs, roadmap) live in separate files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a social feed or keep posts synced back as local markdown files.

relations.evidence: Bidirectional sync between your Obsidian vault and Taggr — a decentralized publishing platform on the Internet Computer.

requires.name: Taggr account via registration page, invite code, or ICP tokens
seed phrase or controller identity key for authentication
cycles to publish posts and images

summary: Bidirectional sync between an Obsidian vault and Taggr, a decentralized publishing platform on the Internet Computer, treating posts as markdown files.
